text:
sam (Release): Quick heads up — cutoff for 0.13.0 in ~2 hours. Please bump any critical PRs now; I will lock main at cutoff. Changelog owners @claire @maria please do a final pass by 09:30 UTC. We plan a small canary to validate latency. If anything looks risky, flag here and we can decide slip vs rollback.

claire (Docs): On it. I will consolidate bullets and add the migration callout. If anyone has docs-only tiny fixes, ping me w/PR numbers.

jonathan (Eng): There's one perf tweak in PR #8421 that needs review (runtime kernel tweak). ETA ~40m for review + CI. If it doesn't merge, I've got a fallback variant ready to cherry-pick. @sam do you want the canary to include kernelA or hold that for a follow-up?

lee (Infra): Canary window scheduled 10:15-10:45 UTC in us-west-2. Please note GPU capacity is tight; plan for fallback. Version bump command for build team: `sed -i 's/0.12.9/0.13.0/' build/version.txt` and include 'release: 0.13.0' in commit message.

sam (Release): Canary should include kernelA but start flagged off. Auto-swap policy: if p99 latency > 350ms for 3m, rollback to fallback. @release-bot please create canary job and post status to #announcements when final.

release-bot: deploy-bot created canary job canary/0.13.0-kernelA. Track: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/0.13.0-kernelA (will post updates every 60s).

maria (PM): Marketing needs final changelog bullets by 10:00 UTC for blog and release note header. @mike can you draft the announce copy? Focus on perf + batching improvements and dedicated capacity controls.

mike (Marketing): Yep — pulling from Claire's doc now. Will post a draft in #marketing in ~30m and ping here for final sign-off.

jonathan (Eng): Note: merge conflict on release-candidate branch for tokenizer change. Might need a quick rebase; if we don't resolve before cutoff, I recommend deferring tokenizer change to the next patch.

sam (Release): Decision rule: if a PR can't land by cutoff due to review or conflicts, we defer to next patch unless it's a critical fix. Call out any exceptions ASAP.

claire (Docs): Changelog updated: https://docs.internal/releases/0.13.0#changelog — added feature bullets and known issues. Please review and comment.

lee (Infra): Infra note: if we see capacity errors during canary in us-west-2, monitoring alert infra/gpu-capacity will trigger; fallback will execute. I've bumped canary alert thresholds to reduce noise.

maria (PM): Marking announce as tentative until canary is green. If we need to slip, we'll post a short notice in #announcements with ETA and reason.

sam (Release): Thanks all. Final reminder: include the exact version string in the bump commit and reference the release issue. I'll lock main at cutoff and publish canary status.
